description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for the PackageManagerImplementation, which manages package downloading, installation, and handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data structures related to package management operations.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the internal state of a package, including installation status, lock count, runtime configuration, and metadata paths.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: JSON configuration container for package manager settings, primarily the download directory.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a download task, including URL, retries, rate limits, and cancellation status.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Initiates a package download with specified options.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and usage details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification for download events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the service context.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package with given ID, version, and metadata.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures a package with specific metadata.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Retrieves the installation state of a package.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for exclusive access.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a locked package.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to populate runtime configuration from package metadata.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to copy runtime configuration.
